title: Filtering Txt = "ab" matches "ab" and "ab " but not " ab"
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Spaces, Spaces[Txt] = "ab" ) ) )

source.quote: The Power BI engine automatically trims any trailing spaces that follow text data, but doesn't remove leading spaces that precede the data
source.supports: trailing spaces are dropped from stored text, leading spaces are kept

derivation: Row 1 is 'ab'. Row 2, 'ab ', is stored without its trailing space, so it is 'ab' too. Row 3, ' ab', keeps its leading space and is not equal to 'ab'. 2 rows.
